title: Cascade Brewery
geometryBasis: The east facade and road alignment come from the current OpenStreetMap footprint. The period photographs and state building descriptions control the vertical steps and the scale of connecting historic ranges.
sectionBasis: The Beattie postcard shows three lower floors, sandstone courses and lower arched windows. The May 1937 public-domain newspaper photograph shows the added upper brewery and lettering. The heritage register describes the seven-level envelope, 1967 damage and low attached ranges.
limitations: The main stepped brewery, connector and historic malthouse are represented. Modern plant buildings, brewery gardens and the bar are separate.
Roof heights, rear wall joints and chimney dressings are approximate. The reference shows the surviving 1927 height and massing.
